name: Brian Wendot
description: A collection of projects, ideas, and things worth sharing by Brian Wendot.

hero.eyebrow: A personal corner of the internet
hero.thought: Curiosity turns ordinary days into interesting ones.
hero.introduction: I like taking an idea, pulling it apart, and seeing what it could become. This is where I keep the projects, experiments, and occasional discoveries that come out of that process.

about: I'm interested in how things work—and what happens when you try to make them work a little better.
Some of that curiosity turns into software. Some becomes an experiment, a note, or simply a question worth following. This site is where I keep the parts worth returning to.
If something here overlaps with what you're working on, I'd be glad to hear about it.
